rule: Regex catches selected advanced constructs; it cannot certify teaching depth. Positive depth limits require manual review. No syllabus exclusion was invented.

entries.pattern: \b(?:ordinary least squares|econometric regression|hypothesis test|confidence interval|statistical significance)\b

must_catch: Estimate an econometric regression of demand.
must_allow: Calculate a simple percentage change in demand.

manual_review_constraints.constraint: Keep theory elementary and data handling basic.
Use simple market situations and simple PED/PES calculations.
Use simple RPI calculation and simple absolute/comparative advantage applications.
Do not create independent income/cross-elasticity units merely from glossary entries.
Do include evidence-backed MC=MR profit-maximisation treatment; do not blanket-ban marginal quantities, economic rent or comparative advantage.
